snippet.title: School of Magic – Official Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106680/School_of_Magic/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=early_access

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/YBXAPkZ

More info: https://parttimeindie.com/school-of-magic

Launches November 10, 2025 on Steam (Windows).

School of Magic: Deck & Slash — a fast, deck-building hack-and-slay where every run forges a brand-new character. Think Diablo-style action meets card-driven strategy: quick runs, escalating power, broken builds.

If you’re a content creator and want to try the beta, hop into the Discord and I’ll help you get set up.

Some parts of this video are using AI.
